causal_paths.input: User opens route project B while the persisted global selector is project A, then invokes a project detail action.
transitions: A project API method currently omits projectContext for many project paths.
http.ts falls back from undefined projectContext to stored project A and emits X-Project-Id A.
JwtAuthenticationFilter compares path project B with header A and rejects the request.
Passing withProjectContext(B) makes the interceptor emit B without altering stored selector A.
The filter accepts the matching path/header pair and existing permission evaluation uses B.
outputs: Project B request completes without path/context mismatch.
